description: This file contains the PHP source code for the OpenCart admin module extension class 'Banner'. It defines the class, its properties, and methods for managing banner modules in the OpenCart admin interface, including functions to display, save, and retrieve module information.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Banner module extension in the OpenCart admin area, including functions to display, save, and retrieve banner module configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the banner module configuration page in the admin panel, setting up breadcrumbs, loading necessary data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration data for the banner module, either adding a new module or editing an existing one based on POST data.
